sources.name: We Work Remotely
sources.review_note: The public RSS page says anyone may use the feed with attribution, but WWR's API Terms & Guidelines also state that WWR data must not be used to build a job search service. GWR therefore will not publish WWR-derived records unless WWR confirms this use is permitted.

sources.name: Remotive
sources.review_note: Keep secondary and public/ungated only. Respect attribution and redistribution restrictions. Prefer official ATS sources for GWR core.

sources.name: Lever Postings API
sources.review_note: Lever's published postings API is designed for company job sites. GWR uses only selected employer sites, stores structured facts, and routes users outward; it does not submit applications or store applicant data.

sources.name: Greenhouse Job Board
sources.review_note: Do not ingest until current public access/reuse rules are confirmed for the exact company job-board endpoint used.
